meta.name: airbnb-listing-detail
meta.description: Fetches complete Airbnb listing details for a given numeric listing ID via the internal GraphQL API, returning title, room type, description, amenities, photos, coordinates, city, house rules, highlights, ratings, review count, bedroom configuration, and property overview. Use when user mentions Airbnb listing details, Airbnb property info, Airbnb room details, get Airbnb listing data, Airbnb amenities list, Airbnb house rules, Airbnb property description, Airbnb detail page scraper, Airbnb rooms detail, Airbnb property page data, Airbnb listing info, fetch Airbnb room details, pull Airbnb listing.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你给的 Airbnb 房源 ID，自动获取该房源的标题、类型、描述、设施、照片、坐标、城市、房屋守则、亮点、评分、评论数、卧室配置和物业概览。
howto.when: 当你提到 Airbnb 房源详情、房源信息、房间详情、设施列表、房屋守则、房源描述等关键词，或要求获取 Airbnb 房源数据时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下 Airbnb 房源 5476930 的详情。
say.note: 返回该房源的所有公开信息。

say.text: 这个 Airbnb 有什么设施和房屋守则？

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can fetch complete Airbnb listing details (title, room type, description, amenities, photos, coordinates, city, house rules, highlights, ratings, review count, bedroom config, property overview) for a given numeric listing ID via an internal GraphQL API.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user mentions Airbnb listing details, property info, room details, amenities list, house rules, property description, or asks to fetch/get/pull Airbnb listing data.

say_en.note: Returns all public info for that listing.
